name: exists_radius_le
statement: T) (V : Finset T) (ha : 1 < a) (c : ℝ≥0∞) : ∃ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r ∧ #(V.filter fun x ↦ edist t x ≤ r * c) ≤ a ^ r

name: pow_logSizeRadius_le_card_le_logSizeRadius
statement: 1 < a) (ht : t ∈ V) : a ^ (logSizeRadius t V a c - 1) ≤ #(V.filter fun x ↦ edist t x ≤ (logSizeRadius t V a c - 1) * c)
